steps.name: identify_brand_and_platform
actions: Use WMI + VDS/chassis code. openDBC explicitly uses both WMI and chassis code for VW/Audi platform matching.
Classify at minimum PQ/MQB/MEB/MLB/J1/PPE/PPC before proprietary scanning.

steps.name: passive_transport_detection
actions: Listen before transmitting; record 11-bit/29-bit and adapter multiplexing path.
Do not infer 29-bit support from FC00 OBDb syntax until normalized.

steps.name: firmware_identity
actions: Preferred VAG multi-DID request: ReadDataByIdentifier F187 + F195 + F182.
openDBC uses RX offset 0x6A for selected SRS/EPS/radar/camera queries and regular addressing for engine/transmission.
Fallback to individual identity DIDs if multi-DID is rejected.

steps.name: platform_specific_dids
actions: Use exact physical/model support evidence before make-level candidates.
Preserve explicit unsupported-command evidence as platform-scoped negative evidence.

steps.name: bounded_fallback
actions: Run remaining VAG route catalogue before generic 11-bit enumeration.
Generic 11-bit: 0x700-0x7F6 excluding 0x7DF, only when CAN11/UDS is confirmed.
29-bit generic enumeration disabled in this profile.
